variants.F: fixed four-cell organism with one shared time-homogeneous cellular rule
variants.G: same cellular model with utility-driven connect/prune and pressure-conflict-driven fork

phase2.purpose: test local capability acquisition without global genome update

phase3.operation: copy high-change/newborn phenotype cells and their internal subgraph into a phase1-identical recipient

structural_principle.connect: persistent positive first-order marginal edge utility -dL/dw
structural_principle.fork: persistent phenotype-gradient pressure + microbatch gradient conflict, only after useful connection is unavailable
structural_principle.prune: persistent negative marginal edge utility for non-protected edges
